verdict.rationale: PostHog has an extensively documented MCP server (mcp.posthog.com) and REST/HogQL query API that let agents run trends, funnels, retention, and SQL queries against live product data, with a live probe confirming the OAuth-gated MCP endpoint is real and reachable. It's corroborated by hosted client support (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Slack bot), CLI SQL execution, and a documented query endpoint with scoped API keys. missing for 10: no independent third-party hands-on report validating query accuracy/robustness at scale (one community comment notes flaky LLM/cohort behavior in the UI, though not specifically the MCP/API query path).
